integrity: Finite exhaustive enumeration of all balanced subsets and legal swaps reproduced by two standalone graph models; independently checkable source and reference outputs attached.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the 20-vertex Desargues graph only; no all-order theorem or broader exchange rule. Novelty priority subject to unindexed prior literature.
title: The sharp four-edge bisection barrier in the Desargues middle-levels graph
